Raworth needs to stop using her #MeToo moment from years ago as a participant trophy, deploying it to pose as putative moral authority on "Sexism" and "Racism".
Does #BelieveWomen force us to believe every snake and cockroach that slithers from her yap?
https://t.co/25CKrHgEuU

Raworth is a dim dud who enjoyed 15 min. of #MeToo infamy and believes she's a Canadian social media expert. Her homilies are propaganda points ingested, regurgitated and excreted by the Conservative Party Centipede. That they passed thru Coyne's colon doesn't make them credible.
